review_candidates.description: Project Role : Engineering Services Practitioner Project Role Description : Assist with end-to-end engineering services to develop technical engineering solutions to solve problems and achieve business objectives. Solve engineering problems and achieve business objectives using scientific, socio-economic, technical knowledge and practical experience. Work across structural and stress design, qualification, configuration and technical management. Must have skills : 5G Wireless Networks & Technologies Good to have skills : NA Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: 5G Core L2 Ops Engineer We are seeking a skilled 5G Core L2 Ops Engineer to join our team. Roles & Responsibilities: Fault Handling & Troubleshooting: NOC Operations support for 5G Core SA network functions in production environment. Monitor alarms, events, health service and KPIs across in-scope 5G Core network functions. Analyze alarms from NetAct/Mansaray, or external monitoring tools. Correlate events using Netscout, Mantaray, and PM/CM data. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to registration, session management, mobility, policy, charging, DNS, IPSec and Handover issues. Handle node-level failures (AMF/SMF/UPF/NRF/UDM/UDR/SDL/PCF/CHF/Flowone/HSM/NCOM, NetAct Nokia EDR restarts, crashes, overload). Handle troubleshooting on 5G Core Database, UDM, UDR, SDL, Provisioning, Flowone, CHF(Charging), PCF(Policy). Perform packet tracing (Wireshark) or core trace (PCAP, logs) and Nokia PCMD trace capturing , Netscout log Analysis. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) , create RCA documents and implement corrective actions. Handle escalations support and provide timely resolution. Maintain accurate shift handovers, operational reports, knowledge articles and recurring-issue records. Identify opportunities for playbook improvement and operational automation while following security and change controls. Session & Service Investigation: Trace subscriber issues (5G attach, PDU session, QoS). Use tools like EDR, Flow Tracer, Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (COM). Correlate user-plane drops, abnormal release, bearer QoS mismatch. Work on Preventive measures for health check & backup. Configuration and Change Management: Create a MOP for required changes, validate MOP with Ops teams, stakeholders before rollout/implementation. Maintain detailed documentation of network configurations, incident reports, and operational procedures. Support software upgrades, patch management, and configuration changes. Maintain documentation for known issues, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Ability to execute approved MOPs, assess pre/post checks, maintain accurate records and communicate service impact clearly. Support integration of new 5G Core nodes and features into the live network. Performance Monitoring: Use KPI dashboards (NetAct/NetScout) to monitor 5G Core KPIs e.g registration success rate, PDU session setup success, latency, throughput, user-plane utilization. Proactively detect degrading KPIs trends. Security & Access Support: Application support for Nokia EDR and CrowdStrike. Assist with certificate renewal, firewall/NAT issues, and access failures. Escalation & Coordination: Escalate unresolved issues to L3 teams, TAC, OSS/Core engineering. Work with L3 and care team for issue resolution. Ensure compliance with SLAs and contribute to continuous service improvement. Reporting Generate daily/weekly/monthly reports on network performance, incident trends, and SLA compliance. review_candidates.description: About The Role ed Resourcing Ltd seeks a Senior Network & Infrastructure Lead Engineer for a permanent, full-time post based in London, offering up to £90,000 plus bonus and health scheme. This hybrid role places you as the technical authority for a business-critical enterprise network and Nutanix estate. You will direct architecture, engineering, troubleshooting, and resilience across a large distributed environment. Working alongside vendors, partners, and managed service providers, you will provide technical challenge and oversight. This hands-on position suits an engineer eager to own complex problems and drive continuous improvement, ensuring optimal performance and stability across the infrastructure. Senior Network & Infrastructure Manager £70,000–£80,000 + benefits South London The Opportunity We are looking for a technically strong and hands-on Senior Network & Infrastructure professional to join the team and play a key role in the continued development the technology and infrastructure environment. This is a role for someone who genuinely loves infrastructure and networking — someone who enjoys getting stuck into complex problems, understanding how things work end-to-end and finding practical solutions. You don't need to be someone whose ambition is to become a CIO or move further and further away from technology. We're looking for a do-er who enjoys being close to the technology, working collaboratively and making things happen. You'll work across a broad infrastructure and networking environment, helping to maintain, improve and develop the technology that supports the wider organisation. Your Responsibilities Will Include Managing and supporting a broad network and infrastructure environment. Working across technologies including Juniper, Fortinet, Cisco and SD-WAN. Working with IP networking, VNETs, subnets and internet protocols. Understanding infrastructure end-to-end, including how networks, servers and wider infrastructure components work together. Investigating technical issues, thinking through problems and identifying practical solutions. Working with third-party suppliers and partners, including overseeing and coordinating technical activity. Following technical direction where appropriate while also having the knowledge and confidence to challenge, investigate and resolve issues. Getting hands-on when required — this isn't a role where you're expected to sit behind a desk and simply manage from a distance. Helping to develop and improve infrastructure capabilities as the organisation continues to evolve. Working collaboratively with colleagues across the technology team. We're looking for someone with a broad infrastructure and networking background rather than someone who only specialises in one technology. You'll Ideally Have Experience With Enterprise networking and infrastructure. Juniper, Fortinet and/or Cisco technologies. SD-WAN. TCP/IP and core networking concepts. VNETs, subnets and virtual networking. Servers and wider infrastructure technologies. Troubleshooting complex technical problems. Working with suppliers and third parties. Taking ownership of issues and seeing them through end-to-end. Experience with Nutanix would be useful, but isn't essential. Training and development can be provided. More important than having every technology on your CV is having the right mindset . We're Looking For Someone Who Is Naturally curious and technically minded. A genuine infrastructure/networking enthusiast. A hands-on problem solver. Comfortable working in a complex environment. Able to think through problems rather than simply follow a checklist. Happy to get involved at all levels when required. Comfortable working with suppliers and following established technical processes. A strong communicator and genuine team player. Someone who can be technical and "geeky" without losing the human side. Motivated by doing a great job and working with good people, rather than simply chasing the next management title. This is an opportunity to join a team where you'll have the chance to work across a broad and interesting infrastructure environment , with exposure to a range of technologies and complex technical challenges. You'll have the support of experienced colleagues who can help you develop your knowledge, while also having the opportunity to bring your own ideas and experience to the team. If you're the kind of person who enjoys figuring out how things work, getting stuck into problems and making infrastructure better , we'd love to hear from you.

Core Knowledge & Skills: Aligns infrastructure strategy to business goals, leads large projects, applies compliance frameworks, designs high availability/disaster recovery and performance optimization patterns, and shapes deployment pipeline design. Work & Complexity: Directs cross-team programs, performs advanced tuning, implements high availability/failover architectures, leads audits, plans growth, and manages budgets. Consulting & Engagement: Provides high-level consulting to leadership, builds roadmaps, negotiates vendor contracts, and sponsors innovation initiatives. Investigate service disruptions and provide root cause analysis reports and implement additional steps to prevent subsequent issues. Support deployments of new hardware and software applications and appliances. Required For This Opportunity Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of experience or a Master’s degree and 3 year of experience. Experience managing secure computing environments to adhere with DISA STIGs and NIST 800-53 controls. Experience monitoring system uptime and performance with tools such as Splunk, Grafana, and SolarWinds. Experience providing detailed technical after-action reports with root cause analysis after outage or security incidents. Familiarity with host-level networking such as instance firewalls. Familiarity with storage provider management such as Network File Systems (NFS). Familiarity with source code management tooling such as GitHub or GitLab. review_candidates.title: Senior IT Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. The IT Support team helps employees get the technology they need to do their best work. As a Sr. IT Support Engineer, you’ll combine hands-on troubleshooting with artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and better support workflows to resolve complex issues and improve the employee technology experience. Your work will help make support faster, more reliable, and easier to use while reducing recurring problems across the organization. Reporting to the Team Lead, IT Support, this role is based in the United States and works with teams across multiple time zones. How We’re Using AI Today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers. This is a remote opportunity within the US. What We're Looking For Bring 5+ years of experience in internal information technology (IT) support, workplace technology, IT operations, or a related field. Troubleshoot complex issues across identity and access, devices, software, software as a service (SaaS), and workplace applications. Use ticketing systems, knowledge bases, service catalogs, and support workflows to manage and improve employee support. Build or improve workflow automations using tools such as Console, Workato, Tines, or similar platforms. Apply AI tools to investigate issues, create knowledge, improve support, or automate routine work while recognizing when human review is needed. Use support metrics such as resolution quality, time to resolution, repeat demand, self-service completion, and employee feedback to evaluate improvements. Communicate technical issues clearly, collaborate effectively across teams, and provide thoughtful support during sensitive or ambiguous situations. Bonus Points For Experience with basic scripting, application programming interfaces (APIs), or technical integrations. Experience with identity and access management, endpoint management, or service-management administration. Experience supporting distributed teams across multiple time zones. What You Can Expect Own complex, ambiguous, or sensitive employee technology issues through resolution, coordinating with Identity, Endpoint, Security, Infrastructure, and Enterprise Systems teams when needed. Participate in a regular support queue rotation while maintaining dedicated time for service improvements. Build and maintain AI-assisted playbooks, automations, triage workflows, knowledge resources, and self-service experiences. Improve onboarding, access, device, and software support workflows. Identify recurring support problems and create durable improvements to the process, workflow, or service behind them. Establish baselines and measure the impact of support improvements, including resolution quality, time to resolution, repeat demand, automation success, and employee experience. Help teammates adopt effective support practices and make sound decisions about automation, human review, specialist escalation, verification, approval, access, and privacy controls. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $109,000 USD and $153,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How We Work With AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others. Our approach to remote work We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. What We Offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs 🩺 Competitive health benefits 🏝 Generous PTO policy Growth and future 📈 RSU program for most employees 💸 Retirement matching program 🔑 Free 1Password account Community 🤝 Paid volunteer days 🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly 🌎 Remote-first work environment Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.
